blocks.text: Tuesday Vargas expressed her support and offered words of hope to hundreds of ABS-CBN employees affected by the network’s recent retrenchment program. The actress-comedian penned a message for the Kapamilyas, including those she had worked with in the past, through her Facebook page on Friday, Sept. 18. “Lubos puso po akong nakikiisa sa 230 nawalan ng trabaho noong nakaraan. Marami po sa inyo ay naging kasama ko sa aking pagsisimula bilang artista at nakabuo po tayo ng maraming magagandang palabas. Pero higit pa doon, marami po tayong mga alaala na nabuo rin na napakaganda,” she wrote. Vargas underscored how she reached […]...
